# Core Summary
This 15-second commercial cinematic piece traces the journey of matcha from natural origins to lifestyle enjoyment, structured in five distinct 3-second narrative beats. Shot 1 establishes the raw ingredients and tea mountains with a macro-to-wide transition. Shot 2 focuses on the artisanal preparation process with dynamic powder and liquid motion. Shot 3 introduces the consumer <ID_A> in an urban cafe setting, highlighting product details. Shot 4 showcases lifestyle versatility through a quick location shift from window side to beach. Shot 5 concludes with a stylized product packshot featuring floating floral elements.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Macro environment of fresh green tea leaves and white jasmine flowers against a soft, diffused background. Transitions to a vast landscape of terraced tea mountains shrouded in morning mist, bathed in warm golden sunrise light.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Close-up studio setting with warm lighting. Focus on a ceramic bowl and bamboo whisk. Background is neutral to highlight the vibrant green powder and liquid dynamics.
[shot3][00:06-00:09] Outdoor urban cafe terrace with dappled sunlight filtering through palm leaves. Background shows a blurred warm-toned street scene. Transition to an extreme close-up of the cup surface.
[shot4][00:09-00:12] Split environment: First, a bright window sill with orange blossoms. Second, a sunny beach with blue ocean and coconut trees in the distance. Natural daylight in both.
[shot5][00:12-00:15] Clean studio product setup. The cup is centered on a textured surface surrounded by orange blossom branches. Soft, even lighting with no harsh shadows.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Female, European/North American, young adult. Long blonde hair, casual stylish summer clothing. Relaxed and content demeanor.
<ID_B>: Tea farmers (background), East Asian, middle-aged. Traditional conical hats and work clothing.
Vocal Characteristics: No dialogue. Ambient sounds and music only.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Extreme close-up of vibrant green tea leaves and white jasmine flowers rotating slowly in soft light. Rapid cut to a wide drone shot of layered tea mountains. <ID_B> figures are visible in the distance picking leaves under warm golden sunlight. Camera pushes in slightly towards the mountains. Sound of gentle wind and birds chirping.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Top-down view of a bamboo whisk stirring green matcha powder in a ceramic bowl, green dust particles float in the air. Jasmine petals fall into the frame. Cut to matcha liquid pouring smoothly into a green paper cup labeled `"Matcha"` with leaf patterns. Liquid splashes gently against the cup rim. Sound of whisking and liquid pouring.
[shot3][00:06-00:09] Medium shot of <ID_A> sitting at a cafe table, holding the cup and reading a book. She lifts the cup to smell the aroma, eyes closing slightly. Quick zoom to extreme close-up of the cup bottom showing a clear QR code. Sunlight creates bokeh in the background. Sound of cafe ambience and distant traffic.
[shot4][00:09-00:12] The cup sits on a window sill next to orange blossoms, <ID_A> looks out the window in profile. Whip pan transition to <ID_A> lying on a beach chair, the cup placed on a small table beside her. Ocean waves roll in the background. Sound of waves and seagulls.
[shot5][00:12-00:15] Static product shot. The green cup is framed by orange blossom branches. A single jasmine petal floats upward from the cup rim in slow motion. Light glints off the liquid surface. Fade to black. Sound of a soft chime and music swell.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Hyper-realistic commercial photography style. Color palette dominated by vibrant matcha greens, warm golden sunlight, and clean whites. High contrast with soft shadows (chiaroscuro) to emphasize texture. Lighting is naturalistic yet polished, mimicking golden hour and soft studio setups. Textures focus on organic details: leaf veins, liquid viscosity, paper grain, and skin tones.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Serene, refreshing, and premium. The progression evokes a sense of purity from nature, craftsmanship in preparation, and relaxed enjoyment in daily life. The mood is uplifting and calming, designed to trigger sensory appreciation for the product.
